Going Commando still doesn't build on Windows with launcher 1.0.1. Tauri hands us the resource folder as a verbatim path, so the bundled Python reaches CMake as \\?\D:\...\python.exe. CMake bakes that into the hostgen step, Ninja runs it through cmd /C, and cmd can't start a program named that way:
"\\?\D:\claude code\OpenRac\Install\openrac\python\python.exe" ... hostgen ...
Das System kann den angegebenen Pfad nicht finden.
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.

commits.headline: ci(android): carry Zig's prebuilt Clang and lld instead of building LLVM (#306)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
The APK's compiler for Going Commando's part was LLVM 19.1.7 built from
source in the Android job: about 50 minutes on every branch whose cache
was cold. It is now Zig 0.14.1's static AArch64 Linux release, which has
Clang and lld of the same LLVM in one program, downloaded at a fixed
version and checked against its SHA-256. The host's Zig of that release
builds a probe with the kit in the APK's build, so the part's commands
are checked before the APK ships. Android's Embree build is cached too.

commits.headline: fix(ci): run the Vulkan test groups on a push too (#307)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
scope runs only for pull requests, so on a push it is skipped, and a
job without its own condition is skipped with it: port-vulkan-enhanced
then failed with its tests skipped. The test groups now ask for the
build's result alone, as the build and the check do.

commits.headline: fix(hdr): make the HDR setting just Off and On (#308)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
* fix(hdr): make the HDR setting just Off and On

The launcher's Settings > HDR had Game/Off/Auto/On and the game's own
setting Off/Auto/On. Both are now Off and On.

On is what Auto was where the system can tell (HDR only while the
display is in HDR mode); where it can't (X11), it tries HDR as On did.
An old "auto" reads as On, and the launcher's old "" (Game) as Off,
the game's default. The launcher now always passes OPENRAC_HDR.

The games import MSVCP140.dll, MSVCP140_2.dll, VCRUNTIME140.dll and

commits.headline: fix(port): keep the freecam chord from the game (#330)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
L3+R3 toggles freecam as before, but its press no longer reaches the
game: R3 opened the map when freecam was turned on or off. On a toggle
the held buttons are held back until let go and the pads are read
again, and a menu opened by its L3 button closes. The chord is checked
before the game reads its pad, only in developer mode or with freecam
on, so R3 alone opens the map as before, with no wait.
